The clause text sets no end date, sunset, expiry condition or revocation trigger of its own, and no held instrument revokes or supersedes it. The national emergency declared in this order was continued for a further year by the Notice of March 24, 2026 (91 FR 15515), which states that it must continue in effect beyond April 15, 2026, so the clause remained in force on 2026-10-14.

research_rationale:
Executive Order 14024 (April 15, 2021, 86 FR 20249) declares a national emergency with respect to specified harmful foreign activities of the Government of the Russian Federation and blocks property of persons so determined. The order is operative on 2026-10-14. Its text has no sunset, expiry condition or revocation trigger. The order itself declared the emergency, so it depends on the emergency staying in force under the National Emergencies Act; the held Presidential notices of April 13, 2022 (87 FR 22431), April 7, 2023 (88 FR 21457), April 9, 2024 (89 FR 25495), April 10, 2025 (90 FR 15523) and March 24, 2026 (91 FR 15515) continue it year by year, and the last continues it beyond April 15, 2026, a date after the cutoff. Executive Order 14114 of December 22, 2023 is the only held instrument that amends the order's text: it strikes and replaces section 7, and it redesignates section 11 as section 12 and adds a new section 11 on foreign financial institutions. Those are later events on the affected clauses; the new section 11 is not an original clause and is not inventoried. Executive Orders 14066, 14068 and 14071 expand the scope of the emergency, Executive Order 14039 is a separate pipeline blocking order that cites the same emergency, and Executive Orders 14329 and 14384 are tariff orders under the same emergency; none revokes, amends or supersedes Executive Order 14024. Executive Order 14294 of May 9, 2025 is a general policy order on criminal regulatory offenses that does not name this order. The held eCFR text of 31 CFR 587.201 and 587.106, checked as of 2026-10-14, still implements the order, and the U.S. Code note under 22 U.S.C. 10802 refers to the emergency this order declared as continued on March 24, 2026.
